# READ:   2026-11-18T03:05Z (UTC), rendered read, chunks 0-1 of 2, single session
# NOTE:   Every column is what the page prints. game_slot is the heading the game sits under
#         (Thursday Night Football / Sunday Night Football / Monday Night Football / blank for the
#         Sunday afternoon block). venue_as_printed is blank wherever the page prints no venue: the
#         by-week schedule page prints a location only for the international fixture, and this round
#         does not fill a venue in from memory or from a ticket/hotel link on the same page.
#         bye_record is printed in the "Teams on Bye" block, not beside the games.
# CODES:  away/home are the club codes the page itself prints in each team's logo URL
#         (https://static.www.nfl.com/league/api/clubs/logos/<CODE>); the fixture slug is kept in
#         game_url so the two can be re-joined. Two label splits are recorded rather than smoothed
#         over: this page prints the Rams as LA (flag F-15: other captures print LAR) and Arizona as
#         AZ (the repository's Week 10 finals file prints ARZ). Joining Week 10 to Week 11 on these
#         codes without an alias drops two clubs silently, so tools/build_fixture_context.py declares
#         its alias table and publishes it.
